arguments.command:
python -c "
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app import app
c = TestClient(app)
r = c.post('/login', json={'username':'demo','password':'demo'})
print('valid:', r.status_code, r.json())
assert r.status_code == 200
assert r.json().get('token')
r2 = c.post('/login', json={'username':'demo','password':'wrong'})
print('invalid:', r2.status_code, r2.json())
assert r2.status_code == 401
r3 = c.post('/login', json={'username':'nobody','password':'demo'})
print('unknown:', r3.status_code)
assert r3.status_code == 401
print('ALL OK')
"
